name: 染色镜片透光率计算器

map.计算染色镜片可见光透射比(VLT)，对比不同颜色与浓度的明视效果: Compute the visible light transmittance (VLT) of tinted lenses and compare the photopic effect at different colors and concentrations
map.📖 查看「染色镜片透光率计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Tinted Lens Transmittance Calculator User Guide"
map.染色镜片透光率 VLT = 基础透光率 × (100 − 染色浓度) ÷ 100: Tinted lens transmittance VLT = base transmittance × (100 − tint density) ÷ 100 × color base factor ÷ 92 × 100; the higher the tint density the lower the transmittance (0% to 100%).
map.驾驶用镜片VLT需≥8%（不可使用4类），夜间驾驶VLT需≥75%。: Driving lenses need VLT ≥8% (Category 4 not allowed), and night driving needs VLT ≥75%.
map.均匀降低各波长光线，不改变颜色感知，最适合日常太阳镜。: Evenly reduces light at all wavelengths without altering color perception, best for everyday sunglasses.
map.增强对比度，改善景深，适合驾驶和高尔夫等户外运动。: Enhances contrast and improves depth perception, suitable for driving and outdoor sports such as golf.
map.平衡各色光透射，减轻眼疲劳，适合长时间佩戴。: Balances light transmission across colors and reduces eye strain, suitable for long-term wear.
map.提高对比度和景深，适合雾天/夜间，但有色觉偏差。: Improves contrast and depth perception, suitable for fog/night, but causes color deviation.
map.时尚装饰色，减少眩光，适合雪地/水面环境。: A fashion/decorative color that reduces glare, suitable for snow/water environments.
map.染色镜片透光率受染色工艺、浓度、镜片材质影响，实际值以分光光度计测量为准。: Tinted lens transmittance is affected by the dyeing process, density and lens material; actual values should be measured with a spectrophotometer.
map.按透光率与用途选染色深度/色。: Choose the tint depth/color by transmittance and use.
map.透光率 80%–43% 为 CAT2（日常）、43%–8% 为 CAT3（强阳）: Transmittance 80%-43% is CAT2 (daily), 43%-8% CAT3 (strong sun), <8% CAT4 (snow/sea, no driving); gray preserves fidelity and brown boosts contrast.
map.黄片提对比适雾天/靶场但失真，绿片舒缓，驾驶选灰/茶 CAT3 不超 8% 下限: Yellow improves contrast for fog/range use but distorts color, green is soothing; for driving choose gray/brown CAT3 not below the 8% lower limit.
map.染色越深越护眼？: Does a darker tint protect the eyes more?
map.否。过深在暗处迫瞳散大反进更多紫外（若无 UV 镀膜），须选带 UV400 的片: No. Too dark forces the pupil to dilate in dim light, letting in more UV if there is no UV coating; choose lenses with UV400.
map.CAT4 为什么禁驾驶？: Why is CAT4 banned for driving?
map.透光<8% 太暗，隧道/夜路危险，仅雪原海上用。: Transmittance <8% is too dark, dangerous in tunnels/night roads; used only on snowfields and at sea.
map.根据染色颜色和浓度计算可见光透射比(VLT)，评估明视效果和场景适用性。: Compute the visible light transmittance (VLT) from the tint color and density and assess the photopic effect and scenario suitability.
map.染色镜片透光率计算器，根据染色浓度计算可见光透射比(VLT)，对比不同染色颜色与: Tinted Lens Transmittance Calculator; compute the visible light transmittance (VLT) from the tint density and compare different tint colors and photopic effects. A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
